text:
Maya: Heads-up: Acme readout next Wed 10am PT. We need final POC success matrix, runbook, and ask for pricing + T&Cs. Can we align today?
Aj: On it. Quick Q: what's minimal success for them? Metrics they care about?
Sophie: From Acme product: latency p95 <= 300ms, intent extraction F1 >= 0.92, false positive rate < 3%, and 99.95% availability during business hours. Cost target <$0.80 per 1k generated tokens (their estimate).
Liam: For those targets, suggested config: gpt-like 7B quantized on Dedicated, batch size 16, KV cache on, prefix caching for common prompts. Expect p95 ~220-280ms in our infra. Throughput ~40 rps per GPU. Tradeoffs: lower memory/stronger quantization may spike latency.
Maya: Good. We also need eval harness + prompt set for the readout. Aj — you ok to own prompts? Sophie, can you share 5 representative user prompts + 100 annotated examples by EOD?
Aj: I can assemble prompt bank and an automated eval. Plan: unit tests + end-to-end scoring with exact-match + normalized F1. Will produce a short notebook and a 1-page summary.
Sophie: Yes, we'll share dataset. Need NDA exception for samples — legal is fine with redaction. Will send by EOD.
Liam: Eval runbook draft (snippet):
```
# run eval
python run_eval.py --model redwood-7b-q4 --prompts prompts.json --gold gold.json --metrics f1,exact,latency
# outputs CSV: prompt_id, model_resp, score_f1, score_exact, latency_ms
```
I'll include environment vars for Dedicated endpoints + token usage logs.
Aj: Pricing question from Acme: can we give a blended POC rate? They asked for 2-week pilot at 100k tokens/day. Recommend $/token and a fixed POC credit. I'll propose $0.0008/token gen + $0.0002/token emb, plus flat $2k setup for dedicated slot. Thoughts?
Liam: We should also list fallback model variant for tight latency: redwood-3b-quant as degraded profile with expected lower cost and p95 ~150ms.
Maya: Security blockers: Acme sent a security questionnaire — data residency + KMS + SOC2. Liam, can you confirm Private deployment option and HSM support? Also need contact for security doc signoff.
Liam: Confirm: Private deployment supports BYOK via customer KMS and HSM integration. SOC2 docs available, will attach link in thread. I can do a 30m call with their security on Thursday.
Sophie: Perfect. Also want go/no-go criteria: if F1 < 0.9 or p95 > 400ms we stop and collect fixes.
Maya: Noted. Next actions:
- Aj: assemble prompt bank + pricing proposal (today)
- Liam: eval runbook + security doc + optional call (today)
- Sophie: share redacted examples + confirm legal ok (EOD)
- Maya: prepare readout deck template + success matrix table
I'll circulate a readout playbook by EOD for review. :thumbsup:
Aj: :thumbsup: I'll put pricing + notebook in a GH gist and post link here when ready.
Liam: :ok_hand: I'll drop SOC2 link and runbook gist in thread.
InfraBot: Reminder: provision-dedicated-slot job queued (job id: pd-4829), ETA 4h. Will notify on completion.
Sophie: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. See you on the readout.
